items.name: BTR New Material Group Co., Ltd.
items.summary: Shenzhen-based anode producer named in the US AD case. Sayari shows it shipping artificial graphite and coke to the Indonesian plant, but no ownership link to it.

items.name: BTR New Material Group Sales Co., Ltd.
items.summary: BTR's sales company at No. 8 Guangyuan 4th Road, Shenzhen. Listed as a supplier to the plant; HS detail not pulled.

items.name: Shenzhen Ruiqing New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.
items.summary: Trader registered in Room 1108 of the 'BTR Building', No. 8 Guangyuan 4th Road. The largest single shipper of graphite and coke to the plant (Dec 2023 – Jun 2026). Appears as three Sayari records.

items.name: Twigg Exploration & Mining, Lda
items.summary: Mozambique graphite miner that shipped natural graphite (HS 2504) to the plant in 2024–2025. Appears as three Sayari records.

items.name: Syrah Global DMCC
items.summary: Dubai trading company that shipped natural graphite (HS 2504) to the plant, Jan–Apr 2026.

items.name: ERG Madagascar
items.summary: Madagascar graphite producer that shipped natural graphite (HS 2504) to the plant, 2025–2026.

items.name: PT Indonesia BTR New Energy Material
items.summary: Anode plant with sites at IMIP Morowali and Kendal. The anchor record: tax ID, LEI and the most trade history (78 sent, 4,083 received).

items.name: PT Indonesia BTR New Energy Materi (record 2)
items.summary: Kendal-only record built from US import data. Same street address as the anchor, name cut off. 37 shipments sent.

items.name: PT Indonesia BTR New Energy Material (record 3)
items.summary: Company-gazette record with only 'Jakarta Barat' as an address. No trade, no identifiers.

items.name: PT Indonesia BTR New Energy (record 4)
items.summary: Trade-data record whose name lost the word 'Material' into the address field. Same Kendal street address.

items.name: PT Indonesia BTR (record 5)
items.summary: Trade-data record with a shortened name and the same Kendal street address. 12 shipments sent.

items.name: Ultium Cells Warren
items.summary: GM–LG Energy Solution cell plant in Warren, Ohio. Received HS 3801.10 from the plant, Jun–Aug 2025.

items.name: Ultium Cells Spring Hill
items.summary: GM–LG Energy Solution cell plant in Spring Hill, Tennessee. Received HS 3801.10, Aug 2025.

items.name: SK Battery America
items.summary: SK On cell plant in Georgia. Received HS 3801.10, Aug 2025.

items.name: StarPlus Energy, LLC
items.summary: Stellantis–Samsung SDI cell joint venture in Indiana. Received HS 3801.10, Mar–Apr 2025.

items.name: General Motors
items.summary: Received HS 3801.10 (Aug 2025) and HS 3801.90 (Dec 2024) from BTR Indonesia records. A top-ten US buyer of HS 3801.10 overall.

items.name: Tesla, Inc.
items.summary: Received HS 3801.10 from a BTR Indonesia record, Aug 2025.

items.name: Aminco Resources LLC
items.summary: US trading company. Received artificial graphite in 0.2–8 mm grades, Sep 2025. Grain sizes suggest industrial rather than battery use (our reading).

items.name: Larpen Metallurgical Service
items.summary: Metallurgical service company. Received artificial graphite in 1–10 mm grades, Jun 2026: likely not battery use (our reading).

items.name: Changzhou Liyuan New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.
items.summary: Chinese company in which Sayari's registry data shows BTR as a shareholder.

items.name: Liyuan (Indonesia) New Energy Co., Ltd.
items.summary: Indonesian company held through Changzhou Liyuan. Shows Sayari can see some of BTR's Indonesian holdings, just not the anode plant.
